definitions.gloss: semi-finished product; work in progress; intermediate product
definitions.explanation: A product that has gone through some stages of manufacturing but is not yet a finished good ready for sale. It may be sold to another manufacturer for further processing or stored as inventory.

examples.japanese: {半製品|はんせいひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: Send the semi-finished products to another factory.

examples.japanese: {半製品|はんせいひん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{在庫|ざいこ}→在庫：04701_zaiko⟧⟦{管理|かんり}→管理：00178_kanri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{課題|かだい}→課題：00132_kadai⟧になっている。
examples.english: Inventory management of semi-finished products has become an issue.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{半製品|はんせいひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{輸入|ゆにゅう}→輸入：01742_yunyuu⟧し、⟦{国内|こくない}→国内：02998_kokunai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{最終|さいしゅう}→最終：02820_saishuu⟧⟦{加工|かこう}→加工：11793_kakou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}っている→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: This company imports semi-finished products and does the final processing domestically.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{半|はん}→半：10460_han⟧ (half, semi-) and ⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧ (manufactured product). Used in manufacturing, accounting, and supply chain contexts. In accounting, semi-finished goods are classified as inventory.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {半製品|はんせいひん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{在庫|ざいこ}→在庫：04701_zaiko⟧: semi-finished product inventory
- {半製品|はんせいひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{加工|かこう}する→加工する：25223_kakousuru⟧: to process semi-finished products
- {半製品|はんせいひん}⟦{倉庫|そうこ}→倉庫：04044_souko⟧: semi-finished product warehouse
- {半製品|はんせいひん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{段階|だんかい}→段階：04515_dankai⟧: semi-finished stage

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{完成品|かんせいひん}→完成品：17426_kanseihin⟧: finished product — a product ready for sale or use
- {仕掛品|しかかりひん}: work in process — an accounting term for products still on the production line
- ⟦{原材料|げんざいりょう}→原材料：18966_genzairyou⟧: raw materials — materials that have not yet undergone any manufacturing
